config.problem_statement: Between Jan and Jun 2026, requisitions in the requisition-to-offer process took a median of [baseline] calendar days from approval to first offer, with 1 in 10 exceeding [P90] days, delaying start dates for hiring managers and risking loss of preferred candidates.
config.goal_statement: Reduce median and P90 time to offer to a level agreed with hiring managers by [date] - target pending approval.
config.scope: Approved external requisitions, all business units, opened Jan-Jun 2026
config.exclusions: Cancelled requisitions (counted separately); internal transfers; executive search

assumptions.statement: Timestamps in the ATS reflect real events (pending sample verification)
assumptions.label: Assumption

assumptions.statement: Calendar days used; business-day rule not yet agreed
assumptions.label: Assumption

questions.question: What time-to-offer do hiring managers need for their critical roles? (VOC)
Is 'First Interview' captured consistently in BU-B?
Were there policy or system changes Jan-Jun 2026?
Which dashboard platform is approved for client data?

risks.description: Personal data exposure in candidate-level extracts
risks.mitigation: Pseudonymised IDs only; no names; approved storage

risks.description: Findings misread as individual recruiter performance

ctqs.definition: Calendar days from requisition approval to first offer extended
ctqs.approved_requirement: Not yet agreed with hiring managers

ctqs.definition: Offers accepted / offers extended (offers >=14 days old)

causes.hypothesized_cause: Role profile not finalised at requisition approval
causes.contributor_role: Analyst (pattern in data - not stakeholder input)
causes.observation: Stage is longest in most cases
causes.evidence_required: Count of reqs with profile edits after approval; Gemba

actions.action: Confirm VOC requirement with 8-10 hiring managers
Verify 30 random timestamps against source e-mails
Run root-cause workshop on open-to-shortlist stage
